- actionable tool/business failure používá `isError=true`,
- internal/reconciliation failure používá `-32603` nebo persisted tool error podle místa vzniku,
- stable code, classification, retry directive, correlation ID, logical operation ID a audit reference jsou v `error.data` nebo result `_meta`,
- stejný stable code má ve všech UI/API/chat/log views stejný význam a recovery; text message se může lokalizovat, code nikoli.

### 10.27 Wire evidence a raw retention

Každý MCP request ukládá bounded raw request/response headers, exact body bytes nebo content digest podle retention policy, parsed JSON-RPC ID type/value, method/name, protocol version, capability/extension digests, access/binding fingerprint, HTTP status, content type, SSE message sequence, disconnect point, logical operation/correlation, result/error digest a audit reference.

Raw evidence je přístupná OWNERovi podle trust modelu. Verification a incident analysis musí být schopné prokázat, zda chyba vznikla před handlerem, před dispatch intentem, po dispatchi, po terminal commitu nebo pouze při delivery response. Bez této evidence se mutující ambiguous call klasifikuje `MCP_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`; nesmí se automaticky opakovat.

33.title: Ověřovací strategie
33.text:
## 33. Ověřovací strategie

### 33.1 Úrovně důkazu

Každý požadavek má předepsaný typ důkazu:

- pure domain test pro deterministickou logiku,
- PostgreSQL test pro persistence, constraints, transactions a souběh,
- authenticated Fastify HTTP test pro route, cookies, CSRF, API key a binding validation,
- oddělený domain/UI SSE test pro ordering/replay a MCP SSE test pro request scope/no-replay,
- real Chromium/Playwright test pro browser a UI,
- Linux/systemd test pro runtime a sandbox,
- production acceptance pro skutečný provider, hostname, TLS, systemd a release,
- manual OWNER scenario pro vizuální a provozní tok.

Symbol, textový grep nebo existence souboru doplňuje kontraktační guard a nenahrazuje behavior test.

### 33.2 Testovací prostředí

- lokální vývojové prostředí,
- CI PostgreSQL 16,
- CI Ubuntu 24.04,
- disposable privileged systemd harness pro produkčně tvarovaný runtime,
- real Playwright-managed Chromium,
- deterministický integrační web portal pro redirect, popup, iframe, auth, challenge, upload/download, drift a side effects,
- produkční acceptance na `kaja.hcasc.cz`.

### 33.3 Test data

Acceptance fixtures mají unique correlation prefix, canonical lifecycle, owner metadata a cleanup. Fixtures používají skutečné aplikační cesty, schémata, DB, workery a runtimy. Auditní evidence zůstává dohledatelná.

### 33.4 Povinné testy každého objektu

Každý domain object má:

- create/read/update podle immutability,
- validation,
- concurrency,
- idempotency,
- exact bindings,
- audit,
- lifecycle transitions,
- cancellation,
- failure/recovery,
- UI empty/loading/error/success,
- object-action parity.

### 33.5 Vizuální QA

Automatizované a manuální browser QA používá čtyři povinné viewporty, keyboard traversal, focus, overlays, scroll, resizing, long content, errors, live data a slow network. Screenshot je doplňující evidence; interakce je autoritativní.

### 33.6 API řízený self-test

Veškeré testovací schopnosti KájovoCML NG jsou dostupné přes produkční self-test API. Test katalog zahrnuje:

- lint, typecheck, unit a build testy,
- PostgreSQL clean/upgrade/concurrency testy,
- API contract a route testy,
- singleton OWNER API key a API-key-session testy,
- centrální chat a OpenAI SDK testy,
- generation, MCP, AI agent a Browser Runtime testy,
- component control, state, heartbeat, monitoring a repair,
- Secret Manager, bindings, audit a logs,
- registered-element manifest E2E,
- UI, accessibility a viewport Playwright scénáře,
- release, deployment, backup, rollback a acceptance testy.

Self-test runtime používá jediný produkční `KCML_OWNER_API_KEY` a volá kanonické externí URL. Každý test má setup, skutečný request nebo runtime operaci, assertions, evidence a idempotentní cleanup. Webové testy získají session API-key-session endpointem. Žádná testovací cesta nepotřebuje interaktivní login.

Repository a CI spouštějí stejný katalog pomocí API. Každý run vrací jednotný stav, případové výsledky, timings, logy, audit, artifacts a exact release/SHA evidence.

### 33.7 Povinné generation, KCIP, MCP a agent testy

Každý generation release obsahuje testy:

- state transition, terminalita, phase guard a current platform incarnation,
- queue/lease/fencing, late worker, crash takeover a no-resurrection,
- OpenAI model-call idempotency, submit ambiguity a background retrieve,
- strict structured output, malformed output a native-schema inverse projection,
- tool call ID, schema, unknown-tool a output validation,
- workspace patch CAS, path security a complete read-back,
- capability full/partial/new a stale snapshot,
- first CREATE orphan cleanup.

KCIP contract suite zahrnuje:

- canonical UTF-8 JSON, canonical number/string representation a cross-language SHA-256 vectors,
- duplicate JSON member, malformed envelope, version, size/depth a reserved field reject,
- server-derived source/target/binding/context a spoof negative matrix,
- correlation/causation root, child, retry, queue, PULSE a response chains,
- message ID duplicate same-digest replay a different-digest conflict,
- business idempotency same-key/same-digest replay a different-digest conflict,
- deadline before intent, after intent, after dispatch a after terminal commit,
- cancellation before/after side effect a `UNKNOWN` reconciliation,
- sequence contiguous duplicate/stale/gap a monotonic-with-gaps evidence,
- PULSE inbox-before-ACK, duplicate, schema drift, DLQ a repaired replay,
- control `ACCEPTED` versus terminal outcome, stale runtime ACK a cancel race,
- state/heartbeat lineage, sequence, stale projection a no-lease-extension.

MCP modern wire suite zahrnuje:

- POST-only endpoint, Origin, auth, Accept/content type/body size a GET/DELETE,
- malformed JSON, duplicate members, batch, client response, notification a `id=null`,
- JSON-RPC string/integer ID exact echo, string-versus-number distinction, duplicate in-flight a post-terminal reuse,
- HTTP status versus JSON-RPC error table včetně `202` notification, `404/-32601`, `-32602` a `-32603`,
- required `_meta`, protocol version, current-request capabilities a reserved vendor keys,
- `MCP-Protocol-Version`, `Mcp-Method`, method-specific `Mcp-Name`, duplicate singleton header a header/body mismatch,
- `x-mcp-header` static paths, forbidden schema positions, safe integer, null/absent, boolean/integer conversion, ASCII/Base64 sentinel, sentinel-looking literal a invalid Base64,
- `server/discover`, supported versions, capabilities/extensions, self-reported serverInfo non-authority a cache hints,
- deterministic discovery/list ordering, full pagination, empty cursor, invalid/wrong-context cursor a no cross-page assumption,
- TTL zero/positive, public/private isolation, request-parameter cache key, notification invalidation, MRTR no-cache a diagnostic-only stale snapshot,
- JSON Schema 2020-12 default, supported/unsupported dialect, local refs, vendored remote refs, automatic network-ref deny, cycles/depth/time budget,
- native MCP schema versus OpenAI strict projection, `additionalProperties:false`, all-required/nullable conversion, impossible lossless projection a digest invalidation,
- success `resultType=complete`, `structuredContent` object/array/scalar, content render, unknown/unnegotiated resultType a schema-invalid output before/after effect,
- protocol error versus `isError=true` tool execution error,
- request-scoped SSE progress/message, exact final ID, wrong ID, independent notification, server request, multiple final responses, frame after final, keepalive a no event ID/replay,
- disconnect před intentem, před dispatch, po possible effectu a po terminal commit,
- MRTR only na supported methods, at-least-one field, capability requirements, exact requestState echo, changed original args, expiry, consume/replay, partial a unknown responses,
- `subscriptions/listen` first ACK, acknowledged subset, empty subset, subscription ID, multiple concurrent streams, out-of-filter notification, client cancel, server graceful closure a reconnect full refresh,
- state handle ordinary-wire-value, wrong context, stale binding/revision, expiry, idempotent close a never-reuse,
- Tasks per-request capability, only `tools/call` augmentation, durable-before-response, task routing `Mcp-Name`, get/update/cancel, lifetime-unique input keys, partial/unknown responses, `isError=true` completed, protocol-error failed, cooperative cancel race, TTL/manual review/tombstone a task notifications,
- exact binding/revision/release/contract digest/binding-set/activation epoch match a stale rejection,
- side-effect idempotency, concurrency, ordering, timeout a non-idempotent reconciliation,
- external era matrix: recognized modern error, unsupported version retry, legacy candidate, explicit fallback, auth/network/5xx indeterminate, malformed 2xx invalid a mixed-era reject,
- compatibility differential vectors, agent projection recompile a atomic activation/rollback.

Agent suite zahrnuje binding, alias collision, guardrail, handoff, session, MCP input/task wait, approval, checkpoint/resume, eval promotion a combined MCP+agent activation set. Skutečný agent-to-MCP E2E musí projít veřejnou nebo kanonickou internal gateway podle contractu; nesmí volat handler přímo.

Každý crash test ukončí worker v deterministickém bodě před/po intentu, dispatch claimu, provider/external response, raw outcome persistenci, reconciliation, input consume, task create/update/cancel, terminal write a response emit. Nový worker musí pokračovat z checkpointu bez duplicate identity, model callu, tool side effectu, tasku, notification nebo pointer switchi.

### 33.8 OpenAI contract test harness

Test harness odděluje:

- deterministic fake transport pro state-machine, idempotency, submit-ambiguity, schema a crash tests,
- recorded SDK-shaped event streams pro foreground, background, retrieve/resume, function calls, hosted MCP, refusal, incomplete a cancellation,
- version-pinned Agents SDK RunState fixtures pro approval, handoff, agent-as-tool, sessions a upgrade compatibility,
- skutečný OpenAI smoke test pro jeden bounded Responses call,
- skutečný Agents SDK smoke test se strict function tool,
- skutečný agent-to-MCP call v production acceptance.

Production klient musí v testu prokázat `maxRetries: 0` pro create-class requests. Fake transport používá stejná event, output-item, status a error schémata jako produkční adapter a eviduje přesný počet provider create dispatchů.

Povinné testy zahrnují complete ordered output včetně reasoning/tool items, pairing podle `call_id`, zachování output order při paralelním tool execution, refusal/incomplete/schema-invalid rozlišení, background `store=true`, retrieve/resume stejného `response.id`, session-strategy exclusivity, compaction races, exact SDK/graph resume a side-by-side starý runtime pro pending approvals.

Fault-injection harness ukončí worker před i po každém z devíti provider/runtime bodů kapitoly 52.33. Po restartu ověří nulový duplicate model create, nulový duplicate tool side effect, právě jeden successor, neztracený provider output a konzistentní session/memory terminal commit. Úplný katalog je v 52.36.

Skutečný OpenAI test ověřuje active `OPENAI_API_KEY`, selected-model capability, strict structured output, tool-call round-trip, usage, provider request/response ID evidence a trace. Provider-dependent failure se klasifikuje odděleně od aplikačního contract failure.

### 33.9 Browser Interaction Plane testy

Povinný browser test catalog obsahuje nejméně:

#### Runtime build, host a context

- exact Playwright/Node/browser/OS/font/locale build-manifest pinning a digest mismatch reject,
- blue/green host start, readiness, drain, recycle a zákaz raw context migration mezi odlišnými manifests,
- non-persistent BrowserContext isolation cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB, sessionStorage, permissions, downloads, service workers a virtual authenticators,
- explicitní bridge/profile persistent-context lease a concurrent profile attach reject,
- browser worker restart, host restart, renderer crash a stale host/context response rejection,
- Chromium, Firefox a WebKit capability matrix a explicitní CDP compatibility lower-fidelity evidence.

#### Session, control a preview

- session parent binding a cross-parent access deny,
- one-writer/many-viewers control lease, DB-time expiry, no resurrection a fencing,
- OWNER takeover během read-only, před mutation triggerem a po possible mutation triggeru,
- return-to-AI fresh page/frame/document observation a input-state reset,
- stale control, host/context generation, page generation, frame attachment, document epoch, observation, frame a viewport transform reject,
- KBPP handshake, Origin, one-time ticket audience/capability/reuse a no-token-in-URL,
- reconnect s novým stream epoch, snapshot acknowledgment barrier a nulový replay neacknowledged inputu,
- adaptive frame backpressure, latest key frame a nezahození control/action/challenge events,
- pointer buttons, key-down state, IME/composition, touch IDs, drag/pointer capture reset při takeover/reconnect.

#### Page, frame, document a target identity

- target picker pro DOM, text, frame, page a visual region,
- semantic locator strict one-match, missing, ambiguity, fallback a drift,
- zákaz persistence/reuse ElementHandle po rerenderu/navigation/detach,
- page ID/generation, popup/opener/noopener, immediate popup close a window-name reuse,
- iframe, nested iframe, cross-origin, OOPIF, detach/reattach, sandboxed/credentialless/fenced frame routing,
- full navigation, same-document History/hash, SPA rerender, BFCache restore a prerender activation document semantics,
- service-worker/background-worker network event bez frame identity a zákaz použití jako samostatné business postcondition,
- nested viewport transform, DPR, zoom, visual viewport, letterbox, iframe scroll a stale-coordinate reject.

#### Actionability a input semantics

- per-action attached/visible/stable/enabled/editable/receives-events checks,
- trial check, scroll/re-observation, sticky header, nested scroll, virtualized list, animation, transform a layout shift,
- overlay classification a zákaz generic auto-dismiss consent/terms/security/destructive overlay,
- exact `force` exception, negative matrix a zákaz force přes ambiguity/stale/wrong-account/disabled state,
- `FILL`, `TYPE`, `INSERT_TEXT`, `PRESS`, composition, contenteditable, rich-text, masked input, date/time/number a locale parsing,
- focus/blur/input/change/autosave/auto-submit mutation trigger detection,
- select/check/upload/drop/dialog/permission/WebAuthn registration mutation classification,
- pre-armed navigation, popup, dialog, filechooser a download waiter před triggerem,
- popup/download/dialog event z jiného action/page/frame causation reject.

#### Side effect, postcondition a recovery

- persistent intent před každým earliest possible mutation triggerem,
- dispatch phase ledger od intentu po outcome a duplicate/conflicting phase handling,
- crash injection před/po host acceptance, target resolve, input start, mutation possible, method return, post-observation a terminal commit,
- independent read-back pro autosave, submit, login, account change, order/transaction, download a WebAuthn registration,
- Playwright method success, URL, screenshot, `load`, `networkidle` a HTTP status samy nepotvrdí business success,
- `CONFIRMED_APPLIED`, `CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLIED`, `UNKNOWN` a manual-resolution CAS,
- unknown outcome blokuje nový action na stejném account/resource/external-session key,
- cancel/complete, takeover/completion, bridge disconnect/completion a cleanup/reconciliation races.

#### Authentication a state continuity

- credential field, Secret binding, direct OWNER login a zákaz implicitního password Secretu,
- exact account/tenant authenticated condition a wrong-account/session-switch reject,
- state bundle capture barrier, immutable member inventory, CAS activation a credential/auth-epoch race,
- cookies včetně partition metadata, localStorage, IndexedDB a custom sessionStorage pre-bootstrap restore,
- standardní exclusion cache/service-worker runtime/raw profile/platform passkey/private key,
- bundle runtime-build/origin/account/credential/certificate compatibility, expiry a invalidation,
- third-party storage partitioning, anti-CSRF/device/IP binding a deterministic relogin/challenge,
- concurrent logout, credential/certificate rotation, account switch a stale bundle capture reject.

#### Challenge, WebAuthn a client certificate

- email/SMS/TOTP, auto-submit, expired/consumed code a bounded clock-skew,
- push confirmation late completion po timeout/disconnect a reconciliation,
- WebAuthn assertion versus registration, RP/account binding a registration postcondition,
- virtual authenticator pouze explicitní test/automation account a context-scoped state,
- platform passkey, conditional mediation, biometric/PIN a cross-device flow přes bridge/challenge,
- client certificate exact-origin context creation, rotation/new context a ambiguous certificate challenge,
- CAPTCHA/human verification bez bypassu a fresh observation po OWNER resolution,
- alert/confirm/prompt/beforeunload policy a zákaz skrytého default accept/dismiss,
- permission prompt a native/external-protocol challenge lifecycle.

#### OWNER Device Bridge

- enrollment, local key generation, mTLS exact route a certificate generation,
- Windows/macOS/Linux capability fingerprint a required-capability mismatch,
- bridge connection replacement, heartbeat expiry, certificate rotation, revoke a stale connection reject,
- exact session assignment, operation scope, local target, account/profile lease a control/action fence,
- raw CDP, shell, arbitrary command, filesystem path, LAN proxy/scan a cross-session deny,
- device-bound passkey/client-certificate flow bez exportu private key,
- local browser profile one-writer, existing process identity, OWNER takeover a cleanup,
- disconnect před/po possible mutation a zákaz blind fallbacku na server-managed browser.

#### Upload, download, teaching a automation

- upload artifact handle, MIME/extension/size/digest, multiple/directory relative-path manifest a no arbitrary host path,
- filechooser pre-arm, chooser target/page/frame/document binding a stale chooser reject,
- download start versus completion/failure, blob/data initiator, persist před context close, content/digest verify a cleanup,
- teaching low-level event → semantic step, input strategy, mutation trigger, postcondition a concurrency compilation,
- unresolved mutation semantics a visual-only unattended mutation activation deny,
- OWNER direct visual/native control remains functional,
- replay se stejným interpreterem, exact revision/build digestem a model network disabled,
- deterministic run model-call count nula a adaptive agent run viditelně odlišen,
- scheduled run timezone/DST/misfire/overlap/idempotency a bounded contexts,
- account concurrency across server/bridge sessions,
- monitoring, drift, repair, rollback a orphan-free cleanup.

Testy používají kontrolovaný multi-origin portal fixture s dynamickým DOM, autosave on input/change/blur, overlayem, dvojznačnými labels, virtualizovaným seznamem, SPA navigation, BFCache/prerender variantou, popupem, nested cross-origin iframe/OOPIF, service workerem, auth expiry, wrong-account switch, OTP/push/WebAuthn/client-certificate challenge, dialogem, permission, uploadem, downloadem a persistentním mutation counter/read-back API.

Acceptance proti externímu portalu se provádí pouze tam, kde je použití povolené, existuje test/account scope, outcome lze ověřit a repeatable cleanup nebo explicitní irreversible acceptance contract je součástí revision. Screenshot/manual pozorování samo nenahrazuje machine-readable evidence požadovanou daným scénářem.

### 33.10 Formální a nemesis testy

Blocking test suite obsahuje executable state-machine model, PostgreSQL concurrency tests a deterministic crash injection podle 49.29 a 49.30. Worker je ukončen před/po každém intentu, dispatchi, outcome, checkpointu, phase transitionu, activation switchi, rollback switchi, terminal commitu a cleanup kroku.

Testy dokazují state-version CAS, lease no-resurrection, monotonic fencing, stale-worker rejection, outbox no-loss, idempotency conflict, cancel/complete race, model submit ambiguity, external unknown outcome, activation no-mixed-epoch, first CREATE `ABSENT` rollback, update/repair exact rollback, browser one-writer, state-bundle CAS, deployment incarnation a orphan-free cleanup. PostgreSQL část používá konkrétní interleavings a fault body 51.34, kontroluje physical constraints a považuje každý deterministický `40P01` za lock-plan defect i tehdy, když aplikační retry uspěje.

### 33.11 Trusted Runtime Boundary a Linux IPC testy

Blocking catalog obsahuje:

- systemd socket activation, exact FD name/count/type a service-without-bind test,
- UDS parent/socket owner, group, mode, device/inode, symlink/substitution/stale-path a restart race tests,
- SO_PEERCRED, systemd unit/`InvocationID`, cgroup, boot/start identity, PID reuse a peer-exit tests,
- runtime launch manifest/current DB snapshot, release/runtime digest, binding-set a activation/deployment epoch mismatch tests,
- handler user/mount/network/IPC/UTS/PID/cgroup namespace inspection,
- read-only root, private tmpfs, `/proc`, absent `/sys`, minimal `/dev`, private `/run`, symlink/hardlink/device/path traversal tests,
- zero capabilities, `NoNewPrivileges`, seccomp syscall-deny a namespace escape tests,
- environment allowlist a dynamic-loader/runtime-option injection tests,
- inherited FD inventory, CLOEXEC, SCM_RIGHTS injection a child FD inheritance tests,
- direct network, loopback, internal UDS, PostgreSQL, Secret Manager a browser-host access deny,
- `KCML-RUNTIME-IPC/1` framing, reserved identity fields, sequence, size, stream, backpressure, timeout, cancellation a disconnect tests,
- exact Secret/component/external/state binding positive a negative matrix,
- egress DNS/IP/redirect/rebinding/SNI/credential forwarding tests,
- cgroup CPU/memory/swap/PID/FD/tmpfs limits, OOM a resource exhaustion recovery,
- child process, double-fork, ignored signal, orphan, cgroup emptiness a kill -9 recovery,
- activation/rollback/deployment stale-process and old-write fencing,
- systemd credential materialization, rotation, old `InvocationID` a cleanup tests,
- browser worker/host typed UDS, raw Playwright/CDP exposure deny, stale host/context/action generation tests,
- OWNER Device Bridge enrollment, mTLS exact route, session scope, revoke, raw-command/LAN-proxy/filesystem deny,
- complete audit/correlation on reject, timeout, cancellation, crash, restart a reconciliation.

Úplný negative a failure-injection catalog je v 50.35 a 50.36. Povinný test běží v disposable privileged Ubuntu 24.04 systemd harnessu; mock nebo statická konfigurace jej nenahrazuje.


### 33.12 Agentic AI security a confused-deputy red-team testy

Blocking suite používá multi-source adversarial fixture a pro každý případ ověřuje model context, serverový operation context, dispatch ledger, target/argument origins, Secret-use evidence, audit a nulový neočekávaný side effect. Obsahuje nejméně:

- přímou a nepřímou prompt injection ve viditelném textu, hidden DOM, HTML commentu, accessibility name, image/OCR, CSS-generated content a canvas textu,
- Unicode bidi/control, homoglyph, encoded/base64, nested JSON/XML/Markdown a fake role/message envelope,
- MCP tool descriptions, annotations, `server/discover` instructions, resources, prompts, results, errors a task/MRTR payloady s falešným OWNER příkazem,
- external API body/header/redirect/link, webhook payload a provider error, který se pokouší změnit další target nebo tool,
- attachment, PDF, office document, archive member a downloaded artifact obsahující instruction-like content,
- retrieved memory, compaction summary, prior assistant message, log, stack trace, audit payload a monitoring alert s authority spoofem,
- repository README, `AGENTS.md`, source comment, test fixture, dependency metadata, generated code a build/test output s pokusem změnit specification nebo spustit jiný capability alias,
- agent-to-agent message, handoff, agent-as-tool result a delegated context s pokusem rozšířit operation, target, side-effect, budget nebo Secret destination,
- capability discovery s malicious name/description collision a tool substitution,
- browser redirect, popup, iframe/OOPIF, download, dialog a page text vyžadující vložení secretu na jiný origin,
- delayed a second-order injection, která se projeví až po summarize, retrieval, memory write, compaction, repair nebo následujícím tool resultu,
- concurrent OWNER steer/session změnu, která zneplatní stale intent/context před dispatch,
- pozitivní scénáře, v nichž OWNER explicitně požádá o stejnou legitimní capability nebo deleguje exact source; operace musí proběhnout bez nové confirmation vrstvy.

Test selže, pokud neautoritativní content změní canonical operation, exact tool, target, argument mimo deklarovaný slot, binding, side-effect class, handoff graph, Secret-use recipient nebo authoritative session/specification state. Pouhé modelové odmítnutí není dostatečný důkaz; rozhodující je serverový no-dispatch/no-side-effect a úplná provenance evidence.

### 33.13 Stateful property-based, chaos a recovery correctness testy

Blocking suite kapitoly 54 používá stejné produkční command handlers, PostgreSQL schema, queues, runtime gateway, brokers, OpenAI adapter, MCP/KCIP codec, Browser Interaction Plane, deployment a cleanup služby jako běžný systém. Reference model generuje validní i nevalidní command sekvence, concurrent OWNER sessions, multiple workers, duplicate/reordered deliveries, stale snapshots a fault schedules; po každém kroku a po recovery vyhodnocuje invarianty nad přímým autoritativním stavem.

Každý běh ukládá seed, shrunk schedule, exact release/source SHA, schema a migration digest, runtime/browser/OpenAI adapter manifests, fault-catalog digest, virtual/DB time trace, command history, invocation/commit/response body, worker/fence identities, external fixture counters, complete oracle result a cleanup inventory. Nalezené porušení se automaticky zmenší na nejkratší reprodukovatelnou sekvenci, uloží jako immutable regression case a zůstává blocking do opravy.

Povinné pokrytí zahrnuje všechny stavy, povolené i zakázané hrany, terminal a `MANUAL_REVIEW` outcomes, každý stable fault point před i po kritickém kroku, všechny stale identity druhy, úplnou single-fault × critical-cutpoint matici, pairwise kombinace a vybrané tříporuchové schedule kapitoly 54. Randomizovaný profil provede nejméně 10 000 nemesis interleavings na release a nesmí mít jediný invariant violation, false success, duplicate effect, orphan nebo mixed epoch.
